- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a recipe for saffron-infused simple syrup.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Saffron-Infused Simple Syrup Recipe: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup water, 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for making saffron-infused simple syrup: soak saffron, combine sugar and water, add saffron mixture, steep and simmer, strain and cool, store.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Saffron threads should be stored in an airtight container, in a dark, cool, and dry place.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] High-quality saffron can last for 2 to 3 years if stored properly.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested sources for high-quality saffron: Penzeys Spices, The Spice House, Amazon, Middle Eastern or Indian grocery stores, specialty food stores.
